topic: Skipping quarterly estimated taxes on gig income vs paying them every quarter (Byron vs Audra)

scenes.narration: Gig workers get fined just for paying taxes once a year. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding a tax form stamped PENALTY, a delivery bag and a laptop beside it, comic burst banner reads FOUR TIMES A YEAR, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Byron and Audra both earn forty thousand dollars driving and freelancing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man byron in a delivery car and woman audra at a freelance laptop, a tag reads FORTY THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Nobody withholds taxes from their pay. It is on them.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a pay app screen showing a deposit with no tax line, a tax form floating with a question mark, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Byron spends as he earns and plans to settle up in April.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man byron spending cash at a restaurant and a store, a calendar page reads APRIL far away, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: April arrives with a nine thousand dollar bill he cannot pay.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man byron staring at a tax bill reading NINE THOUSAND DUE, empty wallet, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Add underpayment penalties and interest. He sets up a plan at eight percent.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a tax notice with lines reading PENALTY and INTEREST EIGHT PERCENT, a payment plan form, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Audra moves twenty five percent of every payment into a tax account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman audra sliding a slice of each deposit into a jar labeled TAXES TWENTY FIVE PERCENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every quarter she pays the estimate online in ten minutes.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman audra at a laptop on a page reading ESTIMATED PAYMENT, a calendar shows four marked dates, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She tracks mileage and expenses, cutting her taxable income.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman audra logging miles on a phone app, receipts sorted in a folder, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: April is boring. A small refund and no penalties.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman audra holding a small refund check, a calm April calendar, a coffee mug, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Byron owes over ten thousand with penalties. Audra owes nothing.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man byron beside a bill reading TEN THOUSAND PLUS, woman audra beside a stamp reading PAID IN FULL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Set aside a quarter of every payment. Pay quarterly. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a jar labeled TAXES and a calendar with four dates circled, kids comic book illustration
